indigodb.title: IndigoDB
indigodb.description: One .indigo schema language drives a typed TypeScript ORM client, shadow-replayed PostgreSQL migrations, WAL logical-replication realtime + React hooks, and a visual ER/Data/SQL/Docs Studio across 11 @indigodb/* npm packages.
indigodb.metaDescription: IndigoDB documentation — schema-first PostgreSQL ORM, versioned migrations, WAL realtime SSE/channels, React hooks, and Studio published under @indigodb on npm.

docsUi.searchHint: Type keywords like @indigodb/client, migrate, realtime, @@allow, or studio.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/cli
packageCards.summary: Unified indigodb CLI for init, db push/pull, migrate dev/deploy, generate, realtime, and studio.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/client
packageCards.summary: Type-safe Prisma-style PostgreSQL delegates, transactions, $auth RLS, adapters & browser-safe SSE SDK.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/migrator
packageCards.summary: Idempotent db push, PGlite shadow-replayed diffs, SHA-256 ledger, and PostgreSQL db pull introspection.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/realtime
packageCards.summary: Logical-replication SSE wakes, HMAC-signed /log replay, Presence/Broadcast channels, and metrics.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/react
packageCards.summary: Browser-safe useLiveTable and useChannel hooks built on useSyncExternalStore and SSR-safe snapshots.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/studio
packageCards.summary: React Flow ER diagram + Monaco .indigo editor, cursor Data Browser, guarded SQL Console & Schema Docs.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/core
packageCards.summary: Central ResolvedSchema IR, validate(), resolve(), attribute helpers, and lossless printSchema().

packageCards.name: @indigodb/compiler
packageCards.summary: WebAssembly .indigo lexer, parser, validator & UTF-16 spans paired with @indigodb/parser and ast.

packageCards.name: @indigodb/generator
packageCards.summary: Emits typed indigo.ts row/input/where/unique types and delegates from ResolvedSchema.

autorix.title: Autorix
autorix.description: Modular, self-hosted Identity and Access Management suite with Google Zanzibar ReBAC, ABAC CEL, OAuth2/OIDC, Zero-Trust PEP proxy, Macaroon API keys, SAML/SCIM federation, and cryptographic audit trails.
autorix.metaDescription: Autorix documentation — self-hosted Zero-Trust IAM suite with Zanzibar ReBAC, ABAC CEL, OAuth2/OIDC, PEP proxy, Macaroons, and SHA-256 audit logging.

docsUi.searchHint: Type keywords like nexus, oauth, webauthn, helm, or macaroon.

engineCards.name: Nexus
engineCards.summary: Google Zanzibar tuple graph with APL compiler, cycle detection, and CEL caveats.

engineCards.name: Themis
engineCards.summary: Sub-millisecond Google CEL policy engine with priority rings, rollback, and fixtures.

engineCards.name: Ego
engineCards.summary: JSON Schema traits, Argon2id (64 MB), RFC 6238 TOTP MFA, and FIDO2 WebAuthn Passkeys.

engineCards.name: Janus
engineCards.summary: PKCE S256, RS256 JWKS rotation, refresh family revocation, and private admin listener.

engineCards.name: Aegis
engineCards.summary: Zero-Trust reverse proxy enforcing auth, ReBAC/ABAC, and HMAC signed identity headers.

engineCards.name: Vulcan
engineCards.summary: Prefixed API keys (av_live_/av_test_) with offline HMAC-SHA256 caveat attenuation.

engineCards.name: Hermes
engineCards.summary: Enterprise federation bridge for Okta, Entra ID, and Google via SAML 2.0 & SCIM 2.0.

engineCards.name: Argus
engineCards.summary: Fleet enrollment tokens (aet_), gRPC heartbeats, and tamper-evident SHA-256 audit chain.

engineCards.name: Console
engineCards.summary: Secure BFF admin portal with 9 Studio workspaces and live Merkle chain verification.
